# Mathéo Delessert — Portfolio

Interactive, physics-driven creative portfolio of Mathéo Delessert. Click a bag, objects fall, click a project to open it. Built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Matter.js, Three.js.

## Projects

- [Korg e-LIVEsEx jewel case — graphic design](https://matheodelessert.ch/index.html?project=korg)
- [Frip'O'Point — motion design](https://matheodelessert.ch/index.html?project=rondpoint)
- [vroomVROOM — motion design](https://matheodelessert.ch/index.html?project=vroomvroom)
- [Between Worlds — datamoshing](https://matheodelessert.ch/index.html?project=betweenworlds)
- [Jingle eracom — motion design](https://matheodelessert.ch/index.html?project=eracom)
- [Premier jour d'été — photographie](https://matheodelessert.ch/index.html?project=premierjour)
- [The portfolio — webdesign/dev](https://matheodelessert.ch/git.html)
